_comentario: Janela de 1h (API_NOTES 12.2/12.2b): slug nominal em America/New_York, resolução por candle 1h BTC/USDT da Binance. Sintético estrutural sobre o padrão informado no adendo 2.
description: This market will resolve to "Up" if the Binance 1 hour candle for BTCUSDT closes higher than or equal to its open. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Down".
